response.overview: This is the seven-hour version, which is the product of a 16-year digital restoration project at the Cinématheque Française. A biopic of Napoleon Bonaparte, tracing the Corsican’s career from his schooldays (where a snowball fight is staged like a military campaign) to his flight from Corsica, through the French Revolution (where a real storm is intercut with a political storm) and the Terror, culminating in his triumphant invasion of Italy in 1797.
response.title: Napoleon (Grande Version)
